hypothesis: The pre-HOT candidate model is bottlenecked by target mismatch. With the same HOT-time features and model family, training directly on the realized outcome of the frozen downstream pullback policy should rank economically useful candidates better than the historical fixed-first-WATCH target.
selection_contract: Each held-out day uses a threshold computed only from the other three training days. No held-out-day future candidate distribution is used.

isolation.features: same pre-HOT ENTRY_FEATURES for baseline and aligned models

next_if_pass: Combine the downstream-aligned candidate selector with Request277 strictly lagged completed-minute pullback risk context.
next_if_fail: Add causal pre-HOT temporal and market-regime context before changing entry or exit rules.
